_readme: Site-level copy for FarawayFound. Everything under 'landing' and 'blog' (except where noted in _changes) was hand-written by the site owner and is kept VERBATIM, quirks included. Do not 'fix' it. 'ui' holds the neutral, functional interface strings. Edit this file, then run: node scripts/build-site.js

blog.footer: the dead social-icon links were removed (owner-approved edit).

stories.title: Stories
stories.intro: There is no better way of expanding horizons than to travel. To live like locals, to experience diverse cultures, and to wander into the wilderness. After all, we are merely a collection of memories, so to explore the world is to enrich ourselves. With this in mind, I hope to embark on a global journey to learn about our world, the life which inhabits it, and to find myself in the process.

about.name: David Chui
meta: Curious mind always seeking my next adventure. Currently a Software Engineer at Spectrum.
about.text: I was born in Xi’an China, raised in Montreal Canada, went to High School in Texas, and graduated from University of Colorado at Denver with a B.S. in Finance and Information Systems. I served in the USAF as a structural engineer at Nellis AFB in Las Vegas, where I met my wife. Home base for us is now the front range of the Rocky Mountains in Colorado, where we are raising our child to be a little mountain man.

hero._readme: Hero slideshow tuning. 'landingFirst' = file stem of the landing photo shown first (the rest are shuffled in the browser). 'blogPhotos' = Landing/web photos (file stems) used to pad the blog hero after the newest stories' covers; only landscapes without people. 'blogStories' = how many of the newest non-legacy story covers lead the blog hero.
hero._shade: Every hero photo is darkened by a flat, neutral amount (0 - 0.6) that is MEASURED at build time from how bright it is where the words sit (scripts/lib/tone.js; dark photos get 0, the most any photo gets automatically is 0.34). 'shade' forces a value for a story whose JSON is not edited by hand, e.g. {"seattle": 0.34}; a story file may also carry its own "heroShade". 'coverPositions' does the same for the cover's CSS object-position, e.g. {"seattle": "50% 40%"}.

_titleTags: Browser-tab title (after "FarawayFound — ") for stories whose original tab title differed from the page title: the owner's own wording is kept. A story file may also carry "titleTag".
_photoBreaks: Optional: {"slug": ["assets/images/slug/photo.jpg"]} names the frames that become full-bleed photo breaks for stories whose JSON cannot be edited (legacy stories). New stories just set "featured": true on a photo. Rules: 3+ paragraphs and 12+ photos, never a portrait, the cover, or a frame whose alt/caption mentions people.
